Why Evangeline’s?

A Love Story in the Stars

The name Evangeline’s is a wink to one of our favorite love stories: Ray and Evangeline from Disney’s The Princess and the Frog. My husband and I have long used Ray and his beloved evening star as a sweet little reference to our own story.

That feeling became the heart of this bakery: something warm, nostalgic and just a touch magical. Evangeline’s is about making the small moments feel worth celebrating—with a tiny cake, a glowing firefly and maybe a few stars along the way.

Baked here at home

Coming soon to the East Valley.

Evangeline’s Sweet Treats is a home-based Arizona cottage bakery preparing to serve Queen Creek, Gilbert, Mesa and surrounding East Valley communities with handcrafted mini loaf cakes for gifts, parties, showers, celebrations and everyday sweet moments.
